In studies of these synthetic fiber-forming proteins, the number of repeats directly correlates with fiber thickness - more repeats lead to thicker fibers due to greater packing density and larger cross-sectional area.

Since BUD80 has the most repeats (80), it would produce the thickest fibers compared to BUD60 (60 repeats) and BUD40 (40 repeats).
